fields.statement: Change set 01M6XE6 (Fix Main is never tested) blames a merge interaction: #374/#375/#376 each green, then #379 red on internal/api schedule and health tests (CI run 42473839029). The evidence says otherwise. Attempt 1's log shows health part disk 'bad: 3.7 GiB free, under the minimum of 10.0 GiB', so the daemon held schedule starts. Attempt 2 of the same run passed at the same commit, and so did #379's next head. Every merged head already contained origin/main (ship merge refuses otherwise, and ship check --main dispatches CI when the trees differ), so main's tree was the tested tree. The real defect is that internal/api Go tests read the host's free disk. cmd/rhiza scripts pin RHIZA_TEST_FREE_BYTES; the Go tests use a Ctx with no Getenv and fall through to daemon.FreeBytes. What should this change set build?
